headlines.title: Sensex plunges by 600 points, Nifty 50 by 230 points: See major gainers and laggards
headlines.description: The Indian stock markets plunged this morning as it opened for trade with crude oil prices weighing on investor sentiments even in other Asian markets. Shortly fater trading began Sensex 30 was at 73,118.71, down 0.80% or 590.98 points while Nifty 50 was at 22,577.05, down 1.03% or 234.30 points.
headlines.author: Avijit Ghosal

headlines.title: Stocks to watch today: BEL, Persistent Systems, NHPC and more in focus
headlines.description: In the stock market today (Oct 22), shares of BEL, Persistent Systems, Seamec, Tata Communications and PC Jeweller could be in focus due to recent developments. Bharat Electronics has received additional orders worth ₹1,011 crore, while Persistent Systems has launched a QIP (Qualified Institutional Placement) to raise ₹4,265 crore. Seamec has secured a contract valued at $55 million.
headlines.author: Avijit Ghosal

headlines.title: Bitcoin Touches $84.6K as SpaceX Earnings Beat Lifts Risk Assets
headlines.description: Bitcoin extended gains to $84,600 as US equities rallied following SpaceX's better-than-expected Q3 earnings, highlighting crypto's tightening correlation with risk assets.

headlines.title: Bitcoin Closes In on $85K as SpaceX Earnings Fuel Risk-On Surge
headlines.description: Bitcoin is pushing toward $85,000 alongside a broad stock market rally, with SpaceX's strong earnings results reigniting investor appetite for risk assets.

headlines.title: Which way will the stock market go? Bernstein lowers Nifty 50 target for 2026
headlines.description: Global brokerage firm Bernstein has lowered its Nifty 50 target for December 2026 from 26,000 to 25,000. The Nifty has room for an upside of about 8%. Following the recent decline, the Nifty's forward PE ratio has fallen to a six-year low of 16.6 times. Despite this, the Indian stock market remains the third most expensive globally. Improving corporate earnings will be crucial for the market's next rally.
headlines.author: Avijit Ghosal
